novel_element: Synthetic aperture radar from a smallsat constellation
displaces: Optical imaging that cloud and darkness defeat
notes: Radar imaging was a state capability at state cost. Putting it on a smallsat is what let a private firm sell all-weather imagery

novel_element: Mid wave infrared thermal imaging from orbit at about 3.5 metre resolution
displaces: Optical imagery that measures reflected light and stops at dusk
notes: Measures emitted heat rather than reflected light, so building energy use and industrial activity are readable at night

novel_element: Facility level methane plume detection from orbit
displaces: Self reported emissions inventories
notes: Turns a reporting obligation into an external measurement, which is why the buyer became the regulator as much as the operator

novel_element: Geolocation of radio emitters from formation flying satellites
displaces: Imaging that only sees what is visible at the moment of overpass
notes: Detects vessels that have switched off their transponders. Sold into sanctions and fisheries enforcement, which makes it contested where it is used as evidence

novel_element: Single satellite radio frequency vessel geolocation
displaces: Cooperative AIS transponder reporting
notes: A European entrant to a method that had been treated as an American speciality

novel_element: Hyperspectral imaging across hundreds of bands
displaces: Multispectral imagery with a handful of bands
notes: Indian entrant selling spectral resolution rather than spatial resolution, which is a different axis of competition in a crowded segment

novel_element: Hyperspectral pipeline leak detection from orbit
displaces: Ground crews and aerial survey flights
notes: The chemical signature of a leak is visible in the spectrum, so inspection becomes a subscription

novel_element: GNSS radio occultation for atmospheric profiling
displaces: Weather balloons and government sounding satellites
notes: Reads the atmosphere from how navigation signals bend through it. A measurement taken from signals already in the sky

novel_element: Acoustic triangulation of gunfire across a city
displaces: Emergency calls from members of the public
notes: Replaces a human report with a sensor reading. Accuracy disputes and the Chicago cancellation in 2024 are the register's clearest case of a method contested by its own buyers

novel_element: Distributed acoustic sensing along installed optical fibre
displaces: Discrete point sensors placed along an asset
notes: Every metre of an existing cable becomes a listening post. The sensor is infrastructure that was laid for another purpose

novel_element: Fibre sensing for perimeter rail and pipeline monitoring
displaces: Patrols cameras and fence sensors
notes: Same substrate as Silixa aimed at security and transport rather than at subsurface energy

novel_element: Four dimensional imaging radar for indoor presence and falls
displaces: Cameras and wearable alarm buttons
notes: Gets into bathrooms and bedrooms precisely because it is not a camera. The privacy property is the product feature

novel_element: Motion and breathing inferred from ambient wifi propagation
displaces: Purpose built motion sensors and cameras
notes: No sensor is installed at all. The household's own router becomes the instrument, which removes the deployment cost that bounded this market

novel_element: Environmental DNA from water and soil samples
displaces: Field ecologists identifying species by sight
notes: A cup of water reports what lives upstream. Turns biodiversity survey from an expert task into a sampling task

novel_element: Wastewater as a population level clinical sample
displaces: Individual testing of individual people
notes: One sample covers a sewershed, so the unit of observation becomes a population without anyone being enrolled

novel_element: Multi pathogen wastewater monitoring network
displaces: Clinical surveillance that only sees people who present
notes: The nonprofit version of the same method, publishing openly where the commercial version sells

novel_element: Passive acoustic monitoring for chainsaws and species
displaces: Ranger patrols and satellite deforestation alerts that arrive after the fact
notes: Hears the logging while it is happening rather than measuring the clearing afterwards

novel_element: Pooled camera trap imagery classified by shared models
displaces: Each project holding and hand labelling its own images
notes: The innovation is pooling and shared classification rather than the trap itself, and the pool is open

novel_element: Commercial radar and sounder satellites for weather
displaces: National meteorological agency observation networks
notes: Private weather observation rather than private redistribution of public observation, which is the older model

novel_element: Surveys served to people who land on lapsed or abandoned web domains
displaces: Recruited online panels and random digit dialling
notes: The frame is a set of domains rather than a list of people, which is what lets it produce numbers in countries where no panel exists and no dialling frame is usable

novel_element: Content fingerprinting inside the television set
displaces: Household meter panels of a few thousand homes
notes: Entry into the register's most closed segment came through the hardware rather than through a panel. Contested on disclosure grounds in the ACR privacy literature

novel_element: Smart television automatic content recognition
displaces: Panel based audience measurement
notes: Same method as Alphonso reaching the market through a different set of manufacturers

novel_element: Network measurement from SDKs in consumer apps
displaces: Operator records and engineering drive tests
notes: Produces network data without the operator's cooperation, which inverts who holds the measurement in that segment

novel_element: Driver owned dashcams as a road imaging fleet
displaces: Dedicated survey vehicles driven by the mapping firm
notes: The imaging fleet is bought and driven by other people, so coverage scales with sales rather than with capital expenditure

novel_element: Cameras on commercial fleets already on the road
displaces: Purpose built mapping vehicles
notes: Acquired by Toyota in 2021, so the method continued inside a carmaker and the independent firm did not

novel_element: Contributor owned dashcams paid per contribution
displaces: Street imaging fleets owned by a mapping company
notes: Combines the contributor owned fleet with a token payment, so it appears under both this type and the incentive type

novel_element: Paid observation tasks pushed to a distributed app workforce
displaces: Enumerator teams dispatched by a field agency
notes: Contested because the same task network has been used for defence contracts and for development monitoring, and contributors are not always told which

novel_element: Residential proxy network routing collection through consumer devices
displaces: Datacentre crawlers that sites can block
notes: The collection point is a consumer's own connection. How that consent is obtained is the substance of the litigation and regulatory attention around the firm

novel_element: Purpose built academic participant pool with enforced pay floors
displaces: General purpose micro task marketplaces used as a subject pool
notes: Competes against a crowd work platform on data quality and on pay transparency rather than on price

novel_element: Volunteer hosted ADS-B receivers
displaces: Air traffic control feeds licensed from authorities
notes: The incumbent in the flight data segment is itself a crowdsourced network, which is why the token entrants had to compete on payment rather than on method

novel_element: Token payment for hosting a GNSS base station
displaces: Commercial correction networks that own their own stations
notes: Contributors buy the hardware and are paid from enterprise revenue through a token buyback, which shifts capital cost onto the network

novel_element: Token payment for hosting an ADS-B receiver
displaces: Volunteer receiver networks that pay nothing
notes: Built directly against the unpaid volunteer model of the incumbents. The competitive claim is about who captures the value, not about the sensor

novel_element: Token payment for hosting a weather station
displaces: National meteorological networks and unpaid hobbyist stations
notes: Density where public networks are thin, paid for by the data buyers rather than by a meteorological budget

novel_element: Drivers paid for connecting their own vehicle telemetry
displaces: Telematics collected by manufacturers and insurers from the vehicle by default
notes: Moves the vehicle data relationship from the carmaker to the driver, which is a property claim as much as a collection method

novel_element: Workers hold royalties on every resale of the data they produced
displaces: Per task payment with no continuing claim on the dataset
notes: The clearest counterexample in the register to the Kenyan annotation model, where the buyer owned the output and the wage was the whole of what stayed

novel_element: Impact sourcing of annotation work with wage floors
displaces: Lowest cost annotation labour wherever it is available
notes: Founded on an ethical sourcing claim and then the subject of Kenyan litigation over moderation work conditions, which is why it is coded contested

novel_element: Community collected Kinyarwanda speech held locally
displaces: Language data collected by foreign firms and licensed back
notes: African language data collected and retained in country, a direct answer to the pattern where the buyer owns the corpus

novel_element: African language models trained on locally built corpora
displaces: Adapting foreign models with data collected by others
notes: Builds the resource and the model in the same place, keeping the dataset with the firm that collected it

novel_element: Online retail listings as a daily inflation measurement
displaces: Monthly price collection by statistical office enumerators
notes: A private daily index competing with an official monthly one, so the competitor is a state agency rather than another firm. The method was demonstrated in the MIT Billion Prices Project from 2008 and the company was formed in 2011

novel_element: Cars in retail parking lots counted from satellite imagery
displaces: Company disclosure and store visit surveys
notes: Contested because it reads a listed company's performance before the company reports it, and the same imagery now serves regulated climate disclosure

novel_element: Imagery derived economic indicators such as oil tank fill
displaces: Reported inventory statistics
notes: Made physical infrastructure legible as a financial time series

novel_element: Village level asset wealth inferred from satellite pixels
displaces: Household surveys such as DHS and LSMS
notes: Contested because it substitutes model output for measurement in exactly the places where the surveys have stopped, so the error cannot be checked against the thing it replaced

novel_element: Hyperlocal estimates from imagery anchored on existing survey points
displaces: Fresh survey fieldwork at each new geography
notes: Depends on a stock of surveys that donor funding is no longer replenishing, which makes the method's accuracy a decreasing function of time

novel_element: Emissions and energy activity read from public satellite feeds
displaces: Operator reported production and emissions figures
notes: Builds a measurement business on imagery that is free to anyone, so the asset is the inference and not the collection

novel_element: Bank accounts aggregated by logging in as the customer
displaces: Data the bank chooses to share
notes: Credential based screen scraping made household finances licensable. Open banking rules were written in part to replace it, which is regulation catching up with a method twenty years later

novel_element: Card transaction panels as company revenue estimates
displaces: Quarterly company filings
notes: Reads consumer purchases at firm level before the firm reports them. Contested on consent grounds because the purchaser never dealt with the data firm

novel_element: Job postings and web footprints as corporate signals
displaces: Analyst estimates and company guidance
notes: Treats the hiring page as a financial disclosure

novel_element: App store telemetry as market share measurement
displaces: Company reported download and revenue figures
notes: Contested after reporting on how some of its measurement SDKs reached devices

novel_element: Local language media reports coded as conflict event data
displaces: Official casualty statistics and incident reports
notes: Made news reporting into a structured panel, which is now the standard source for conflict research

novel_element: Open source video and imagery verified as investigative evidence
displaces: State intelligence and accredited journalism
notes: Demonstrated that publicly posted material could establish facts that governments contested

novel_element: Local language casualty claims archived and put to belligerents
displaces: Military reported strike assessments
notes: Contested by the militaries whose figures it disputes, which is the point of the method rather than a defect in it

novel_element: Platform video preserved before deletion as legal evidence
displaces: Evidence gathered by investigators on the ground
notes: The adversary is content moderation: collection has to outrun the platform's own deletion, a constraint no other collector in the register faces. The method began in the Syrian Archive in 2014 and Mnemonic was formed around it in 2018

novel_element: Spatial and architectural reconstruction from open sources
displaces: State forensic investigation
notes: A university unit producing evidence admitted in courts and inquiries, competing on method with state capacity

novel_element: Aggregated environmental data for African geographies
displaces: Datasets built for other continents and applied to Africa
notes: Addresses a data scarcity that is itself the product of where earlier collection was aimed

novel_element: Tree level crop measurement from drone and satellite imagery
displaces: Field scouting by agronomists
notes: Per tree rather than per field, which changes what an insurer or a lender can underwrite

novel_element: Drones that choose their own search path for environmental crime
displaces: Patrol vessels and piloted survey flights
notes: Built for enforcement budgets that cannot cover the water, which is a design constraint rather than a technical preference

novel_element: Appliance level consumption disaggregated from one meter signal
displaces: Submetering each circuit or appliance
notes: Nothing new is installed and nobody is asked anything. The new data is produced entirely from a record the utility already held

novel_element: Health state inferred from short speech samples
displaces: Clinical assessment in a consulting room
notes: Contested on validation grounds. Embedding in chipsets from 2021 moves the collection point into the handset baseline

novel_element: Electrodermal activity at the wrist as a clinical signal
displaces: Fitness metrics from consumer wearables and in clinic monitoring
notes: Regulatory clearance is what separates it from the consumer wearable market it physically resembles

novel_element: Shelf condition read from photographs by computer vision
displaces: Human auditors walking the aisle with a clipboard
notes: Entered retail measurement against an entrenched duopoly by changing who does the looking

novel_element: User initiated speed tests aggregated into network measurement
displaces: Operator reported coverage maps
notes: The measurement is a by product of a free consumer tool, which is the oldest version of this pattern in the register

novel_element: Interactive voice response surveys over basic phones
displaces: Face to face interviewing and smartphone panels
notes: Reaches people who have a phone but not literacy or data, which is a population no other modality in the register covers well

novel_element: Person generated health data from consumer devices with consent
displaces: Clinical trial data collected in clinical settings
notes: Pays participants and keeps the consent explicit, which is what distinguishes it from passive health telemetry
